answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require stake escrowed into a slow-release vault: each agent deposits tokens that vest like a glacier crossing a tundra — visible, trackable, and expensive to fake. New identities climb a ridge of escalating trust: small tasks first, larger ones only after peer attestation accumulates. A single entity spawning many clones reaches no summit faster, because total escrow and the audit trail scale with every identity it mints.
